Intelligent ModelRouter Gateway

RouteIQ

Dynamic Cost-, Latency- & Quality-Aware AI Inference Gateway

RouteIQ is an intelligent inference router that dynamically directs every prompt to the optimal AI model under strict cost, latency, and capability constraints. It saves up to 75% on inference expenditure while mathematically guaranteeing zero SLA violations and seamless failover.

USP 1 Hard Constraints

Mathematical SLA Enforcement

Every candidate model is filtered through hard latency, cost, context, and capability gates before inference. Any model violating a constraint is rejected. If no model qualifies, RouteIQ cleanly refuses with explainable recommendations.

Open Interactive Gateway →
USP 2 Zero-Creep Failover

Shrinking-Budget Failover

When an endpoint slows down or fails, RouteIQ deducts elapsed time from the user's budget ($L_{\text{rem}} = L_{\text{orig}} - t_{\text{spent}}$) and fails over to an alternative compliant model without ever relaxing constraints or breaching SLAs.

Test Failover Invariants →
USP 3 < 2.4ms Decision

Laya System 1 Decision Engine

An ultra-fast non-autoregressive complexity estimator classifies incoming queries into easy, medium, or hard tiers. Rule 4 Uncertainty Hedging automatically elevates tiers when ambiguity is detected, preserving answer quality.

Explore Routing System →
